contact.name: David Lamphere
contact.evidence_quote: Founded in 1991 and first led by David Lamphere, LMS has evolved into a recognized leader in the fuel gauging industry. George and Elizabeth Lamphere played a pivotal role in driving the company’s growth, transforming it from its initial stages into a trusted partner for leading aerospace and defense manufacturers. Their passion for aviation and commitment to superior solutions solidified LMS’s reputation.
